name: musikube
description: Terminal-based music player with curses interface and audio library management

musikcube.description: Terminal-based music player with ncurses interface for audio library management
musikcube.usage:
musikcube # Launch terminal music player interface
musikube --help # Show command line options
musikube --library /path/to/music # Specify music library location
musikube --scan # Scan and update music library
musikube --play # Start playback automatically

musikcube-gui.description: Graphical user interface version of musikcube music player
musikcube-gui.usage:
musikcube-gui # Launch GUI music player
musikube-gui --library /path/to/music # Start with specific library
musikube-gui --fullscreen # Start in fullscreen mode
musikube-gui --minimized # Start minimized to system tray
